review.reviewMethod: Complete review of all thirty scientific-name rows on the official Indiana DNR page with exact current-catalog binomial matching only.

contradictions.subject: source-spelling-versus-catalog
contradictions.priorState: The official page prints Hygrophilia polysperma as one regulated row.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The current catalog does not contain that exact binomial; the related catalog spelling is not silently substituted.
contradictions.resolution: The source row remains blocked for explicit taxonomy review and creates no applicability decision.

contradictions.subject: rule-membership-versus-occurrence
contradictions.priorState: The official page designates thirty aquatic plants as invasive and prohibits specified commerce and transport.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The page does not provide a complete county occurrence survey or explicit negative evidence.
contradictions.resolution: Only exact state regulatory applicability is recorded. No county presence, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable claim is created.
